_llm_instructions: Fill out the 'project_title', 'date_prepared' properties, and the 'value' properties for each field in this Decision Log template based on the provided project context.

Category.guidance: Document the type of decision, such as technical, project, process, etc.

Decision.guidance: Provide a detailed description of the decision.

Responsible party.guidance: Identify the person authorized to make the decision.

Priority.guidance: Enter the date the decision was made and authorized.

Comments.guidance: Enter any further information to clarify the decision, alternatives considered, the reason the decision was made, and the impact of the decision.
